### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately report all patient-stated symptoms. Do not generalize denials; a denial of specific symptoms does not negate other symptoms previously affirmed in the transcript.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Strictly limit content to direct patient statements. Do not include medical diagnoses, professional assessments, or objective findings (e.g., vital signs, exam results) in this section; these belong in Assessment or Objective.
